scope: Two independently authored native pulse SFX and a directed data-only edit. Actual original and generated CPU/APU routines verify volume, duty, nearest canonical pitch, terminal-buffer frame, source initialization ambiguity, ordinary canonical edits, persistence and unchanged Forge SFX ownership/restoration. Controlled routine calls isolate one update per frame; this is not general SFX recovery, native arbitration replay, identical waveforms, full-game timing, speaker output, browser or hardware acceptance.

arbitrationDifference.canonicalContract: One imported SFX owns its chosen channel and restores saved music state; native arbitration is not transcribed.
